name: artifact-callbacks
description: Turn clicks on HTML pages Claude writes into follow-up prompts in the running session, through a loopback-only listener

port.title: Port
port.description: Fixed loopback port for the listener (0 picks a random free port each session)

confirm.title: Confirm events
confirm.description: first-per-page: ask before the first event of each page; always: ask before every event; never: run events straight away

artifactsDir.title: Artifacts folder
artifactsDir.description: Folder the listener serves pages from, relative to the session's working directory

allowFileOrigin.title: Allow file:// pages
allowFileOrigin.description: Accept events from pages opened straight from disk, authenticated by a per-page token

maxPromptChars.title: Max prompt length
maxPromptChars.description: Cap on the rendered prompt for one event, in characters

autoStart.title: Start automatically
autoStart.description: Start the listener with the session; when off, run /callbacks start

streamReplies.title: Stream replies to pages
streamReplies.description: Write Claude's reply text for each event where the page can stream it from /_cb/events/<id>/stream
